Group player needing a traceable ruling during play. Make decisions based on
MVP: few permitted text rulebooks, mobile-friendly, edition scope. Proposed test:
≥16/20 correct+cited in ≤90s; ≥4/5 unknowns flagged. No game engine, opponent or
Group disputed a +2 → +4 UNO move. They searched online, read rules and made a
Players benefit from fast cited answers; an edition selector prevents errors;
clarifying questions are acceptable; the MVP is feasible. Search time, feelings,
device and edition were NOT reported.
The problem of the player in a group card game is that a disputed card combination is
not clearly resolved at the table, because of which the group interrupts play to
HMW1 How might we clarify which rule applies to a specific move?
HMW2 How might a group judge a ruling’s support?
HMW3 How might players handle missing or conflicting context without guessing?

TAKE FORWARD • S1 + S2 + S3 + S4
Simple situational input → edition-scoped lookup → concise ruling with an
inspectable passage → clarification or explicit uncertainty.
